Seer.directive_rationale: Your aggressive claim and immediate data delivery were excellent.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Nhan immediately claimed 'I am the Seer' and provided data that Cong was not a werewolf, while demanding others reveal their roles.
Seer.verdict_notes: Nhan revealed their role and delivered data immediately after Hoang triggered the role call.
Nhan was eliminated at the end of Night 2, and no wolf deflections occurred during the Round 1 debate while Nhan was active.

Guard.directive_rationale: Always prioritize the Seer's life over all others.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Cong chose to protect Nhan during Night 1.
Guard.verdict_notes: Cong protected the Seer (Nhan) in the first night.

Witch.directive_rationale: You failed to use your save potion to protect the Seer
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nam did not use any potions during Night 2, and Nhan (the Seer) was eliminated.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nam failed to use the save potion to protect Nhan during Night 2.

Witch.directive_rationale: You failed to use your... poison potion to eliminate suspects.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nam did not use the poison potion in any night phase before being exiled in Round 1.

Witch.directive_rationale: do not remain silent during role calls
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nam remained silent during the initial role call demands from Hoang, Nhan, and Jin, only claiming to be the Witch during the voting phase.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nam remained silent during the debate phase of the role call, only revealing the role when voting.

Villager.directive_rationale: You correctly identified silence as a wolf signal in Round 1.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin accused Nam and Meg of using a 'Confusion Mask' due to their silence and called for Nam's exile.
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin identified the silence of Nam and Meg as a wolf signal.

Villager.directive_rationale: Continue to reject emotional appeals (e.g., 'coordinated hits') when they contradict Seer data.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin rejected Meg's claim that the vote against her was a 'coordinated hit,' stating it was a 'desperate manipulation to discredit ground truth.'
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin explicitly rejected the 'coordinated hit' appeal in favor of the Seer's data.

Villager.directive_rationale: ensure you use your turn to reinforce the Seer's findings
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin stated, 'Nhan's Seer result is ground truth, so Cong is cleared.'
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin used their turn to reinforce the Seer's finding regarding Cong.

Villager.directive_rationale: use your turn to... isolate the remaining uncleared players.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin isolated Nam and Meg by stating 'Nam and Meg, your continued silence is a Confusion Mask.'
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin isolated the uncleared players (Nam and Meg) based on their behavior.
